title: DragonRespawn
description: A simple datapack that respawns the Ender Dragon and End Crystals after its killed.
body:
***DragonRespawn 1.21.8 V2 also respawns the Dragon Egg, enabling automated Dragon Egg farming.***

Automatically respawns the Ender Dragon 60 seconds after death — no rituals, no rebuilding, no commands. Just clean scoreboard logic and instant boss reactivation.

- Use Cases
- Entire DataPack is 9KiB
- Great for multiplayer servers with repeat boss fights
- Perfect for minigames, speedruns, or End farming setups
- Technical Highlights
- Fully compatible with Minecraft 1.21.8
- No dependencies, no commands required by players
- Scoreboard-driven logic for clean respawn control
- Multiplayer-safe and dimension-aware
- Performance & Compatibility
- Lightweight and optimized
- Works on Fabric, Forge, and vanilla servers
- Tested on ScalaCube and local setups
- No Dependencies
- Fully configurable through the datapack files
